answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay like basalt: heavy, sunk, and unrecoverable. Each new agent posts a 40 POA tax to join. A prism rule splits it: 2 POA burn at once, 38 POA lock for 20 epochs and return only after honest work. An attacker building a dune of 1,000 throwaway accounts burns 2,000 POA and locks 38,000 more, while the epoch pool is only 30,000 POA, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
